entries.title: Exodus 40:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 40:2
segments: On the day of the first month, on the first of the month, shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 40:3
segments: And thou shalt put in it the ark of the testimony, and shalt cover the ark with the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:4
segments: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it. And thou shalt bring in the candlestick and light its lamps.

entries.title: Exodus 40:5
segments: And thou shalt set the golden altar for the incense before the ark of the testimony; and hang up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:6
segments: And thou shalt set the altar of burnt-offering before the entrance of the tabernacle of the tent of meeting.

entries.title: Exodus 40:7
segments: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and shalt put water in it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:8
segments: And thou shalt fix the court round about, and hang up the curtain at the gate of the court.

entries.title: Exodus 40:9
segments: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is in it, and shalt hallow it, and all its utensils; and it shall be holy.

entries.title: Exodus 40:10
segments: And thou shalt anoint the altar of burnt-offering, and all its utensils; and thou shalt hallow the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.

entries.title: Exodus 40:11
segments: And thou shalt anoint the laver and its stand, and hallow it.

entries.title: Exodus 40:12
segments: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons near, at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and bathe them with water.

entries.title: Exodus 40:13
segments: And thou shalt clothe Aaron with the holy garments, and anoint him, and hallow him, that he may serve me as priest.

entries.title: Exodus 40:14
segments: And thou shalt bring his sons near, and clothe them with vests.

entries.title: Exodus 40:15
segments: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may serve me as priests. And their anointing shall be to them an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

entries.title: Exodus 40:16
segments: ¶And Moses did so: as Jehovah had commanded him, so did he.

entries.title: Exodus 40:17
segments: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first of the month, that the tabernacle was set up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:18
segments: And Moses set up the tabernacle, and put in its bases, and fixed its boards, and put in its bars, and set up its pillars.

entries.title: Exodus 40:19
segments: And he spread the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above over it; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:20
segments: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and put the staves in the ark, and put the mercy-seat above on the ark.

entries.title: Exodus 40:21
segments: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and hung up the veil of separation, and covered the ark of the testimony; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:22
segments: And he put the table in the tent of meeting, on the side of the tabernacle northward, outside the veil,

entries.title: Exodus 40:23
segments: and arranged the bread in order upon it before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:24
segments: And he put the candlestick in the tent of meeting, opposite to the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

entries.title: Exodus 40:25
segments: And he lighted the lamps before Jehovah; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:26
segments: And he put the golden altar in the tent of meeting before the veil.

entries.title: Exodus 40:27
segments: And he burnt on it fragrant incense; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:28
segments: And he hung up the curtain of the entrance to the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:29
segments: And he put the altar of burnt-offering at the entrance to the tabernacle of the tent of meeting, and offered on it the burnt-offering and the oblation; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:30
segments: And he set the laver between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.

entries.title: Exodus 40:31
segments: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet out of it:

entries.title: Exodus 40:32
segments: when they went into the tent of meeting, and when they drew near to the altar, they washed; as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 40:33
segments: And he set up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and hung up the curtain of the gate of the court. And so Moses finished the work.

entries.title: Exodus 40:34
segments: ¶And the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:35
segments: And Moses could not enter into the tent of meeting, for the cloud abode on it, and the glory of Jehovah filled the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 40:36
segments: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel journeyed in all their journeys.

entries.title: Exodus 40:37
segments: And if the cloud were not taken up, then they did not journey until the day that it was taken up.

entries.title: Exodus 40:38
segments: For the cloud of Jehovah was on the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, before the eyes of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
